descriptor: Family fruit farm with shop, cafe and cider

voice.summary: Sounds like a farm shop owner leaning on the gate: warm, a bit cheeky and always in season. It talks about fruit, weather and recipes, and promises only what the trees can deliver.
dos: Tie updates to the season and what is ripe
Use homely words like boxes, cider and pick your own
Keep a dry joke in reserve for the footer
donts: Do not spam promises like daily offers

taglines: Apples, cider and the odd fact
From our trees to your table
Seasonal, local and a little bit wild
boilerplate: Orchard Farm is a family-run fruit farm that sells seasonal boxes, gifts and cider, runs a farm shop and cafe, and sends a monthly letter of recipes and apple facts.

microcopy.success: You're on the list. See you next month.
microcopy.error: That email doesn't look right. Please check it.
microcopy.empty: No orders yet. Pick a box to begin.

logo.note: A young shoot is the simplest picture of a working orchard.
